blockingFindings.title: R3 does not cover reviewed HEAD binding
blockingFindings.rationale: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for one of its required evidence binding fields.
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires repair evidence to bind both reviewed HEAD/tree, but the spec-local tests only model and assert reviewedTree. No test would fail if reviewed HEAD were omitted from the evidence contract or ignored by the gate.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local coverage that supplies the expected reviewed HEAD value and rejects evidence whose reviewed HEAD is missing or mismatched.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An acceptance requirement has no corresponding spec-local test coverage for one of its required evidence binding fields.
